name: NetSuite
label: NetSuite — SuiteTalk REST record + SuiteQL (OAuth 2.0)
description: Official SuiteTalk REST record + SuiteQL (OAuth 2.0). Docs: https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/book_1559132836.html. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. DO NOT BUILD SOAP / new TBA (Oracle 2026.1+ prefers REST + OAuth 2). saved_search omitted — use SuiteQL. Host is https://{account_id}.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com (account_id interpolated into baseUrl). Prefer: transient on SuiteQL is not sent by OfficialApiNode.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for NetSuite. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: record_get | record_create | record_update | record_delete | suiteql. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: NetSuite record internal id for record_get / update / delete. Example: 12345.

schema.label: type
schema.description: REST record type path segment. Official: customer | invoice | salesorder | contact | … Example: customer.

schema.label: record
schema.description: SuiteTalk REST record object merged at the JSON root for record_create (POST /services/rest/record/v1/{type}) and record_update (PATCH …/{type}/{id}). Field names are the record type's REST properties (companyName, email, entityId, …). Named inputs win on conflict. Example: {"companyName":"Acme","email":"ops@example.com"}. https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/netsuite/ns-online-help/article_159239242881.html

schema.label: q
schema.description: SuiteQL query string for suiteql. Example: SELECT id, companyName FROM customer.

schema.label: params
schema.description: SuiteQL params array for suiteql. Official query parameters object/list.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: record_get | record_create | record_update | record_delete | suiteql. Default record_get. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: NetSuite REST access token (bearer Authorization). OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack. StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Account Id
configurationParameters.description: Account id for the REST host {account_id}.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com. Interpolated into baseUrl.
